title.narrative: Solar pumping stations for sustainable water services in rural Mali

description.narrative: UDUMA has developed a model that provides water services in rural areas. A “ppp” type project was launched in Mali in 2019 to rehabilitate 1400 manual pumps. Unfortunately, population participation was limited and operational results poor. Changes had to be made. A pilot introducing solar pumping stations has demonstrated the positiv impact of these infrastructures. Revenues generated by the solar stations can cross subsidize the services for the pumps. The goal is now to get enough solar facilities installed to be able to sustain the pumps and increase the consumption of safe drinking water.

description.narrative: Determine the number of separate operational/business units./organizations. The result of the profit margin calculation is a percentage � for example, a 10% profit margin means for each $1 of revenue the company earns $0.10 in net profit. Revenue represents the total sales of the company in a period. Calculate over minimum of 6 months._

title.narrative: Other indicators (P) and narrative explanation
Please provide a short narrative explanation of the data here. (max 250 words)

actual.value: We use the reference of 500 people per water point created to calculate the number of beneficiaries on the project, which brings us to a total of 27,500 people reached by the initiative (45 solar stations + 10 piped extensions build on existing solar stations). We ultimately did not take into account the 18 solar stations of Vitol No. 1 funding for the following reasons: these water points are not listed in the project budget, and were installed during a period prior to that of the project. They are also never mentioned in the final reports. Consequently, we preferred not to list them here. However, the number of people trained remains unchanged, because we trained 55 caretakers, but also 2 Uduma agents in Impact Pump technology. 1 Uduma agent was also trained in the registration system, complaint management during the project period. We also trained 1 area manager. And 6 facilitators have capacity building on awareness-raising and lobbying activities, particularly to address low consumption on Impact Pumps/Thermofluidics infrastructures.
